    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a rwb_document, rwb_case or v_ace_* object
    When the boundary test runs

    Then nothing is released

    Given the legal action carries an action_type outside LOV-LEGAL-TYPE
    When the action is checked

    Given the checked pack holds the documents of case "RC-2026-000705"
    When the decision record and the workflow input are written
